'兄さん' (brother) is unassigned to a speaker in the table; contextually plausible as Holland reacting to learning Dewey (his canonical older brother) is behind the attack, but not asserted as fact -- translated as a bare address/thought.

'ベントロール' (Vent Roll, transliterated) and 'ラーダー' (rendered 'Rudder') are ship-part/control-surface terms with no hit in the glossary or an English-language wiki search; see batch_03883_glossary_proposals.json entries. Unidentified speakers/addressees (opponents, pilots, 'he/it' referents) kept gender-neutral or left as pronouns matching the source's own ambiguity; no identity or gender invented from context alone.
